whatItDoes: Group plans die in the group chat. OurSpaces gives a friend group a persistent shared canvas — countdowns, polls, potluck sheets, photo piles, reading cards — that every member sees update live, cursor to cursor. 32 widget types, one realtime board per space.
frontend: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4, served by @convex-dev/static-hosting mounted at "/"; our own HTTP routes sit under /api.

schema.tablesNote: 11 tables of our own; @convex-dev/auth's ...authTables are spread in on top and not counted in the 11.
schema.typedWidgetData: widgets.data is a 33-arm union (convex/widgetData.ts): 32 typed per-widget validators plus one open fallback arm for pre-union rows.

features: Realtime reactive queries drive every board and thread.
Cursor pagination (.paginate) on message threads; full-text search index on messages, filtered by spaceId.
Vector index widgets.by_embedding + ctx.vectorSearch (convex/similar.ts): an arriving link asks whether the board already holds it.
Scheduler, internal mutations, 4 crons (convex/crons.ts), file storage behind the photo walls.
HTTP router (convex/http.ts): token-streaming /api/ask-stream and an svix-HMAC-verified inbound AgentMail webhook.

components.aggregateNote: memberCounts and pollTallies ARE @convex-dev/aggregate: convex.config.ts registers that component twice under those names, so code calls components.pollTallies / components.memberCounts, never components.aggregate.
components.authNote: "auth" is @convex-dev/auth, a library rather than an app.use'd component; authWellKnown is our own component, mounted at /.well-known for OIDC discovery documents.

auth.modes: Anonymous guest sessions, plus join with a six-digit code emailed from the space's AgentMail inbox (convex/otp.ts).
auth.note: Identity comes from getAuthUserId(), so a scan for direct ctx.auth calls finds none.

chatModels: @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b — via a Cloudflare Workers AI proxy, preferred when AI_PROXY_URL + AI_PROXY_TOKEN are set
gpt-4o-mini — direct OpenAI API when the proxy is unconfigured; a config-time choice, not a runtime failover
ai.scannerNote: A scan may report no model ids: they are string constants in convex/ai.ts, not inline SDK model literals.

highlights: 17 component references across 16 installed components, each with a job: migrations backfills legacy rows, two aggregate instances replace .collect() counting, sharded-counter drives the landing totals, rate-limiter guards every LLM/mail/paint path.
action-retrier + action-cache wrap the Firecrawl and AgentMail calls, workpool bounds the daily recap fan-out, workflow makes the Friday digest durable, batch-worker drains the stale-link queue.
"Ask the space" = an agent thread for memory, rag for retrieval, persistent-text-streaming pushing tokens over /api/ask-stream.
Every space has a real AgentMail inbox and mail arrives as furniture on the board; a pasted URL becomes a Firecrawl-enriched reading card.
Convex hosts both halves: static-hosting serves the React build at /, convex/http.ts owns /api.
